See below

Sent from Yahoo Mail for iPhone

Begin forwarded message:

Hello,

Thanks for writing in. The forwarded part of your message didn't come through on our side, so all I can see is "See below" with an empty thread underneath. That happens now and then with mail forwarded from a phone.

Could you reply and paste the details straight into the body of the email? If it's about a miner you're thinking of buying, tell me your budget, where it will run and roughly what you pay per kWh, and I'll tell you honestly which unit makes sense and what it ships on. If it's about something else entirely, just say the word and I'll pick it up from there.

Happy to help once I can see it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
